integrity: Analytical proof with independent of experiment finite exact-arithmetic checks; original literature contributions and limits identified.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to irrational Sturmian rotation codings with one aperiodic residue and a finite disjoint decorative alphabet; historical priority for unpublished equivalent formulations has not been excluded.
title: Exact maximal-pattern profiles and de Bruijn extremizers for decorated Sturmian rotations
